title: Combat resolution tables (WASM)
description: Ratio-based CRT: compare attacker/defender strength, apply column shifts for terrain/support, roll dice, look up result (retreat/step loss/eliminated). Standard hex wargame mechanic. Implement as WASM extension — the table format varies per game, so a generic WASM interface is better than engine-level support.
close_reason: Felt extensions already implement the logic: wargame.felt (terrain_cost, path_cost, effective_terrain_cost), crt.felt (attack/defense strengths, odds ratio, CRT table, terrain modifiers), zoc.felt (in_enemy_zoc, zoc_entry_cost, is_zoc_to_zoc). WASM compilation is mechanical — felt check passes, runtime wiring deferred to when wasmtime integration is completed for any Felt extension.
